### Whip pan over recursive zoom
<a id="l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom"></a>

He skips the source's recursive zoom ("shrink the shot into a picture of itself, 3 levels deep, then push through it with a spin and blur") as "a bit too much" and uses a whip pan, which "looks cleaner". Measured: about 5 frames of horizontal motion blur into a new framing, with a whoosh and a hit.

**How:** Whip: 4-6 frames of directional blur/offset across the cut + whoosh starting ~2 frames before it. CapCut: Transitions > Swipe/Whip, ~0.2 s.

> For transitions I skipped the recursive zoom and went with a whip pan. It looks cleaner.

`edit` · formats: reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches: all · stated · from [L10](../sources/L10.md)
